question.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{c}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,d=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{c}_{1}+{x}_{2}{c}_{2}=d,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{c}_{1}+{x}_{2}{c}_{2}=d,$ then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}0=4 \\ 2{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=5 \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=1\end{aligned}
$$

The first equation is a false statement. Hence,the system has no solution.
